business_summary.text: Birlasoft is a global IT services company providing digital transformation, business process management, and technology solutions across Banking, Financial Services & Insurance, Manufacturing, Energy & Utilities, and Life Sciences.

call_points.text: Q2 deal TCV stood at $116M ($47M new, $69M renewals); H1 TCV reached $285M, up 15.0% YoY.
call_points.versus_prior: delivered on guidance of higher H1 deal wins YoY

call_points.text: EBITDA margin came in at 15.2%, holding above the 15% guidance target despite organization-wide compensation increases.
DSO improved to 51 days from 55 days QoQ, representing a two-year best.
Total headcount stood at 11,142 with LTM attrition moderating to 11.1% from 11.7% in Q1FY27.
Wage hike effective July for all associates; full impact 170-200 bps, about half in Q2.
Management maintains 15%-plus EBITDA margin target despite investments.
Manufacturing and E&U softness to continue for a couple more quarters; E&U turnaround expected from Q3.
Unbilled revenue at March 2026 was higher than expected due to delayed documentation; regularized in Q1.
No numeric revenue guidance; management cites market volatility.
Steady-state EBITDA margin is expected to moderate to upward of 15% due to investments in sales and AI capabilities.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,348.62 Cr (+2.4% YoY), net profit ₹175.93 Cr (+44.1% YoY).
Birlasoft Limited shared its May 6, 2026 earnings call recording on its website.
Birlasoft held its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 6, 2026, highlighting a 2.4% YoY revenue growth and margin expansion.

On 28 July 2026, Birlasoft's Q1FY27 earnings call reported revenue of ₹1,379.4 Cr (up 2.3% QoQ), EBITDA margin of 16.1%, and TCV signings of $168.7 mn, with management guiding to a 15%-plus margin and a 29-30% FY27 tax rate.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,416.2 Cr (+6.6% YoY), net profit ₹159.65 Cr (+37.5% YoY).
Audio recording of the earnings call organized on 28 October 2026 is available on the company website.
